name: office-document-preview
description: Read-only preview of text documents, spreadsheets, slides and drawings inside a VS Code tab. Powered by a headless LibreOffice.

commands.title: Office Document Preview: Open in LibreOffice
Office Document Preview: Locate the LibreOffice executable

officeDocumentPreview.sofficePath.markdownDescription: Full path to the `soffice` executable. When set, it wins over automatic detection. Leave empty to search the usual install locations and then the `PATH`.

officeDocumentPreview.conversionTimeoutM.markdownDescription: Base milliseconds to wait for a conversion before killing the LibreOffice process tree. Time is added per megabyte on top of this; see `#officeDocumentPreview.conversionTimeoutPerMegabyteMs#`. The base has to cover LibreOffice's first run, which costs 17 to 20 seconds however small the document.

officeDocumentPreview.conversionTimeoutP.markdownDescription: Extra milliseconds allowed per megabyte of the source file. Conversion time grows with the document: a 317 KB spreadsheet takes under 2 seconds, while a 13 MB presentation takes 33 seconds on a native machine and 73 in a virtual one. Set to `0` for a flat timeout that ignores size.

officeDocumentPreview.conversionTimeoutM.description: Ceiling for the whole budget, however large the document. This is what still catches a conversion that is genuinely stuck rather than slow: a password-protected document waits for a prompt that never appears, and would otherwise wait for ever. Raise it if you routinely open very large documents.

officeDocumentPreview.cacheEnabled.markdownDescription: Keep converted documents so that closing and reopening a tab does not convert them again. The cache is keyed by the file's **SHA-256**, so editing a document invalidates its entry immediately and the previous conversion is deleted; touching or moving a file that has not changed keeps it.

officeDocumentPreview.cacheMaxBytes.description: Disk budget for the conversion cache, in bytes. When it is exceeded, the entries nobody has opened in longest are removed first. 0 empties the cache and keeps it empty.

officeDocumentPreview.cacheMaxAgeDays.description: Delete cached conversions that have not been opened for this many days. Swept once when the extension starts. 0 disables the age limit and leaves only the size budget.

officeDocumentPreview.warnAboveBytes.description: Ask before converting a source file larger than this many bytes. 0 disables the warning.
